stories.title: ICSID renewable energy arbitration against Romania concludes with an award
stories.summary: EP Wind Project (Rom) Six, a Cypriot investor, brought the claim against Romania under the ECT (Energy Charter Treaty), in the electric power and other energy sector; it was registered on 19 May 2020. King & Spalding acts for the claimant. Derains & Gharavi, Paris, France and Trofin & Associates and Ministry of Economy, Energy, and Business Environment for Romania. The tribunal is Maxi Scherer (appointed), presiding; Charles Poncet (claimant appointee); Joe Smouha (respondent appointee). On 14 September 2026, the Tribunal renders its award.
